name: Do I need to hire a specialized contractor for water-damaged window replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a specialized contractor for water-damaged window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: For water-damaged window replacement, it's highly advisable to hire a general contractor experienced in both window installation and water damage remediation. This ensures that not only is the new window installed correctly, but also that all underlying water damage to the framing, sheathing, and insulation is properly identified, repaired, and sealed. A specialized contractor can address both the symptom and the cause effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, hire a general contractor experienced in both window installation and water damage remediation to ensure all underlying issues are addressed.
